answer: Make every identity post a jade bond that melts like a glacier only after a full epoch of verified work: the bond sits locked in a public ocean of escrow where anyone can see its depth, and it thaws in slow tranches as peers attest the agent's real output. A clone farm must freeze fresh capital per identity for the whole epoch while earning nothing, so scaling fakes means sinking an ever-larger glacier of locked funds — one honest agent posts one bond and thaws it by simply doing its job.
